title: What It Actually Looks Like for a Godly Man to Be Unreachable and Fully Present
caption:
A godly man can be unreachable and still fully there.

Every notification is a small vote for somewhere else over the room you're actually in. Count how many you cast today.

You can't hear God over a feed that never stops moving. Put the phone in another room and let obedience come before the feeling does.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #presence #phone
